lines.en: Good morning! Are you busy today?
Yes, very busy. We begin a new project today.
lines.ko: 네, 아주 바빠요. 오늘 새 프로젝트를 시작해요.

lines.en: What is my first task?
Please check the schedule and call the members.
Okay. I finished the last project yesterday.
Great job! The office will be free after three.
lines.ko: 잘했어요! 사무실은 세 시 이후에 한가할 거예요.

lines.en: Will the work end early today then?
Yes. We will end at four and go home.
lines.ko: 네. 네 시에 끝내고 집에 갈 거예요.

lines.en: I like this job. The people are kind.
lines.ko: 저는 이 직업이 좋아요. 사람들이 친절해요.

lines.en: Me too. Let's begin now. Thanks for your help!
When does your work end today?
At five. I'm free after that. Why?
lines.ko: 다섯 시요. 그 뒤로는 한가해요. 왜요?

lines.en: Let's have dinner together after work.
Good idea! Are you busy tomorrow morning?
No, my schedule is free. I begin at ten.
lines.ko: 아니요, 일정이 비어 있어요. 열 시에 시작해요.

lines.en: Then we will walk in the park after dinner.
Last week I was too busy for a walk.
lines.ko: 지난주에는 너무 바빠서 산책을 못 했어요.

lines.en: I know. We worked hard all day yesterday.
lines.ko: 알아요. 어제는 하루 종일 열심히 일했어요.

lines.en: So tonight we will rest and talk.
Great. See you at five at the office!
